style_block: Cinematic night-time render of a software system built as physical architecture. Dark graphite and smoked-glass modules, like minimal server units and service blocks, floating at different depths and connected by very thin fibre-optic lines. Data travels as small mint light pulses. Deep forest-black environment (#07100D), soft emerald and signal-mint light (#67E39B, #A3F6C1), light volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens character, fine film grain. Precise, calm, engineered, premium. One green colour family only.
negative: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable screens or UI, no people, no hands, no keyboards, no cityscape, no sci-fi spaceship, no server-farm photo, no cables in a mess, no blue, no cyan, no purple, no orange, no red, no rainbow, no lens flare streaks, no watermark

assets.name: Hero keyframe
assets.prompt: A wide cinematic view of a running software system at night. On the right 55 percent of the frame, a loose constellation of about twelve dark smoked-glass modules floats in layered depth: one larger central core module, and around it six distinct clusters of smaller modules, clearly separated from each other with space between them. Each cluster has a tiny mint status light. Hair-thin fibre-optic lines connect every cluster to the core, and a few small mint light pulses are caught mid-travel along the lines. A faint grid floor fades into haze below. The left 45 percent of the frame is calm, dark, nearly empty negative space with only soft haze, reserved for large headline typography. Lighting: the core glows softly from within, mint rim light on module edges, the rest in deep forest-black. [style_block] [negative]

assets.name: Hero loop video
assets.tool: Google Flow, Veo 3.1 Quality, Frames to Video
assets.prompt: Locked-off camera, absolutely no camera movement: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no dolly, no rotation. Every module, cluster and fibre line stays exactly in place and keeps its size and shape for the whole shot. Only light moves. Small mint data pulses travel smoothly along the fibre lines from the core out to each cluster and back, unhurried, a few at a time. The tiny status lights on the clusters breathe softly, slightly out of sync. The core's inner glow swells and settles once. The haze drifts very slowly from right to left. The final frame matches the first frame exactly so the clip loops seamlessly. Calm, hypnotic, premium, cinematic night. One green colour family only. No new objects appear, no text, no flashes, no colour shifts, no lens flares.
checks: camera and objects do not move at all
